lines.l: Changing views, the change of seasons, will leave you no clues
As desperation spreads, within a broken soul, life leaves you feeling dead
But just like Matthew singing, on a lowdown Sunday afternoon
Baby, I'm just looking into your eyes
Show you from the way you make me high
It's everything you are to me
Perfect, and everything I am to you
Come through a lot of trying stages
From the realms of our own self-made pages
Baby, let's look into your eyes
Chasing from the whale makes me high
Blue box, it's everything you are to me
Blue box, and everything I am to you
Seems like it could last for you
Drowning in a sea of trees, little yet I know
Baby, you still look into your eyes
Changing from the way you make me hide
It's everything you are to me
And everything I am to you
Ooh, perfect, na na na, perfect, it's perfect, cause ya perfect, ooh yeah, perfect.
